title: Flutter Developer
description:
We are looking for a **motivated and skilled Flutter Developer with 1\+ years of hands\-on experience** to join our development team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building, testing, optimizing, and maintaining high\-quality cross\-platform mobile applications using **Flutter and Dart**.

The candidate should have strong practical experience in **Flutter development, REST API integration, state management, Firebase, mobile application architecture, and app deployment**.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain **cross\-platform mobile applications** using Flutter and Dart.
* Build **responsive, user\-friendly, and pixel\-perfect UI** based on UI/UX designs.
* Integrate **REST APIs** and handle JSON data effectively.
* Implement state management using **BLoC, Cubit, Provider**, or similar frameworks.
* Integrate Firebase services including:
* Firebase Authentication
* Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
* Firebase Crashlytics
* Implement secure authentication and user management.
* Integrate **third\-party SDKs, APIs, and services** as required.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues and crashes.
* Optimize application performance, stability, and responsiveness.
* Collaborate with **backend developers, UI/UX designers, and other team members**.
* Write clean, scalable, reusable, and maintainable Dart/Flutter code.
* Conduct testing across different **Android and iOS devices**.
* Prepare and publish applications on the **Google Play Store and Apple App Store**.
* Participate in code reviews and follow development best practices.
* Maintain technical documentation when required.

Key Requirements

**Must\-Have Skills**

* **1\+ years of hands\-on Flutter development experience**
* Strong knowledge of **Flutter and Dart**
* Good understanding of **Flutter widgets and responsive UI**
* Experience with **REST API integration**
* Good knowledge of **JSON parsing and API error handling**
* Hands\-on experience with **BLoC / Cubit / Provider** or similar state management
* Experience with **Git and GitHub/GitLab**
* Basic to good knowledge of **Firebase**
* Understanding of **Android build and release processes**
* Knowledge of **mobile application architecture and reusable components**
* Ability to independently **debug and resolve technical issues**

Good to Have

* Experience with **iOS development and App Store deployment**
* Experience with **Firebase Cloud Messaging and push notifications**
* Knowledge of **Dio, Retrofit**, or similar API clients
* Experience integrating payment gateways such as **Razorpay, Cashfree, or Stripe**
* Knowledge of local storage such as **SharedPreferences, Hive, or SQLite**
* Experience with **Google Maps and location\-based services**
* Basic knowledge of **Node.js, Express.js, or MongoDB**
* Experience integrating third\-party SDKs and APIs

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering**, or a related field is preferred.
* Strong **problem\-solving and analytical skills**.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Comfortable working in a **fast\-paced development environment**.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on **real\-world Flutter applications**
* Exposure to **modern mobile development technologies**
* Collaborative and supportive work environment
* Opportunities for **continuous learning and career growth**
* Competitive salary based on **skills and experience**

Key Hiring Criteria

**Flutter \+ Dart \| REST APIs \| BLoC/Cubit/Provider \| Firebase \| Git \| Android/iOS \| Debugging \| App Deployme**

Work Location: In person

title: iOS Developer
description:
**Company:** Fusion My Business

**Domain:** Fintech \| POS

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a skilled iOS Developer with 2–4 years of experience to build and scale a

production\-grade iOS application.

The role involves developing a mission\-critical merchant platform that supports:

 Merchant onboarding and KYC

 Card payments \& Tap\-to\-Pay on iPhone

 POS \& inventory management

 Payouts, analytics \& finance tools

You will collaborate closely with Product, Backend, QA, and Design teams to deliver a secure, high\-performance, and delightful merchant experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

 Design, develop, and maintain native iOS applications using Swift

 Build high\-performance fintech \& POS workflows (payments, orders, refunds, reports)

 Implement secure APIs for authentication, transactions, payments, and dashboards

 Integrate payment SDKs such as Stripe, Apple Pay, Tap\-to\-Pay, and card readers

 Handle real\-time data, background synchronization, and offline\-first workflows

 Apply MVVM / Clean Architecture principles

 Write and maintain unit tests, UI tests, and performance tests

 Debug crashes, memory leaks, and performance bottlenecks

 Work closely with Product \& UX teams to deliver pixel\-perfect UI

 Support App Store releases, updates, and version upgrades

**Required Skills**

 2–4 years of hands\-on experience in iOS application development

 Strong proficiency in Swift

 Experience with UIKit and/or SwiftUI

 Solid understanding of REST APIs \& JSON

 Knowledge of Apple Human Interface Guidelines

 Experience integrating payment SDKs or fintech APIs

 Local data storage using Core Data / SQLite / Realm

 Experience with Push Notifications, deep linking, and background services

 Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and App Store deployments

**Good to Have**

 Experience in Fintech, POS, Payments, or Banking applications

 Hands\-on experience with Stripe, Square, or SumUp\-style platforms

 Knowledge of security, encryption, tokenization \& PCI compliance

 Experience integrating Bluetooth devices (card readers, printers, kiosks)

**Why Join Fusion My Business**

 Build a UK\-focused Fintech \& POS platform

 Work on real payment flows and financial products

 Opportunity to grow into Senior Engineer / Tech Lead / Architect

 Exposure to global merchants and high\-scale transaction systems

 Product\-driven culture with real ownership and impact

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Your Expected CTC?
* Notice Period or LWD?
* Your Current CTC?

Work Location: In person

title: Sr Android Developer
description:
**Job Title: Android Developer with Kotlin and Jetpack**



About Us


*"Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by* *Avtar \& Seramount**. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100\+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.*

*WHY JOIN CAPCO?*



You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.


*MAKE AN IMPACT*



Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.


*\#BEYOURSELFATWORK*



Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.


*CAREER ADVANCEMENT*


*With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.*


*DIVERSITY \& INCLUSION*


*We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.*


*Experience: 5\+ Years Work Mode: Hybrid (Work from Client Office)*

  



Key Responsibilities:



Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high\-performance Android applications using Kotlin and Java. Take ownership of features throughout the development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing and production release. Contribute to application architecture, coding standards, and engineering best practices. Write clean, maintainable, and testable code while actively participating in code reviews. Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including Product, Design, QA, and Backend Engineering, to deliver intuitive and user\-centric solutions. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, bugs, and application stability issues.



Required Skills \& Experience



Strong hands\-on experience in Android application development using Kotlin and Java. Deep understanding of the Android SDK and modern Android development frameworks. Proficiency with Jetpack Components such as ViewModel, Room, LiveData, Navigation, and related libraries. Solid experience implementing MVVM and Clean Architecture principles. Strong knowledge of application security, secure coding practices, and compliance requirements. Experience with unit testing, code quality tools, and CI/CD practices is preferred. Excellent problem\-solving, debugging, and communication skills.



Preferred Qualifications Experience building enterprise\-grade or large\-scale mobile applications. Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and collaborative development environments.



***If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.***

description:

: 1

**Job Description:**
**Mobile app Architect**

 **Core Skillset for Mobile App and Spring Boot Java**

 **Architecture documentation**

  

C4 diagrams, technical standards, architecture review reports.

 **Cloud/backend understanding**

  

AWS/Azure/GCP basics, API gateways, load balancing, caching, queues, databases, scalability

 **Mobile security**

  

OWASP MASVS/MSTG concepts, root/jailbreak considerations, secure logging, secrets, reverse engineering risks

 **Authentication \& security**

  

OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, refresh tokens, secure storage, certificate pinning where justified, biometric auth, session management

 **Spring Boot integration**

  

Should understand Spring Boot sufficiently to evaluate API contracts and mobile/backend interaction

 **API architecture**

  

REST/JSON, API versioning, pagination, error handling, retries, idempotency, WebSockets if applicable

 **Mobile architecture**

  

Clean Architecture, modularization, dependency management, separation of UI/domain/data layers, scalability

 **iOS \& Android**

  

Strong understanding of both platforms, including native build/configuration, permissions, push notifications, deep links, lifecycle, background tasks

title: Mobile Application Developer Intern
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a **Mobile App Developer Intern** who is passionate about mobile application development and interested in gaining hands\-on experience by working on real\-world projects. The intern will work with our development team to build, test, and improve mobile applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in developing mobile applications for Android and/or iOS platforms.
* Convert UI/UX designs into functional mobile application interfaces.
* Develop new features and improve existing application functionality.
* Integrate **REST APIs and backend services**.
* Work with databases and application data.
* Perform testing and debugging of mobile applications.
* Identify and fix bugs and performance issues.
* Assist in implementing authentication, notifications, and other app features.
* Collaborate with developers, designers, and project managers.
* Maintain clean, organized, and reusable code.
* Participate in application deployment and maintenance activities.
* Learn and follow mobile development best practices.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of mobile application development.
* Knowledge of **Flutter / React Native / Android / iOS**.
* Basic programming knowledge in one or more of:
* Dart
* Java
* Kotlin
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* Swift
* Basic understanding of **REST APIs and JSON**.
* Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
* Understanding of basic UI/UX concepts.
* Good problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies.

Preferred Skills

* Basic experience with **Flutter or React Native**.
* Knowledge of Firebase.
* Understanding of push notifications.
* Basic knowledge of Google Maps or location services.
* Familiarity with mobile app testing.
* Knowledge of databases such as MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
* Personal or academic mobile application projects.

Educational Qualification

* B.E / B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc Computer Science / IT or a related field.
* Students and recent graduates with relevant technical skills are encouraged to apply.

What You Will Learn

* Real\-world mobile application development.
* Flutter / React Native development.
* API integration and backend connectivity.
* Mobile UI development.
* Database integration.
* Debugging and application testing.
* Git and collaborative development.
* Mobile application deployment.
* Complete mobile app development lifecycle.

Ideal Candidate

* Passionate about mobile application development.
* Eager to learn and work on real\-world projects.
* Strong logical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Able to work independently and take responsibility for assigned tasks.

**Skills:** Flutter \| React Native \| Android \| iOS \| Dart \| Kotlin \| Java \| JavaScript \| REST API \| Firebase \| Git \| Mobile UI/UX

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund
